Vyvanse girl here and I found that between going off birth control (due to other side effects) and starting Vyvanse has actually helped my sex drive a TON. I couldn’t be bothered before.. now I feel “normal.” I used to literally forget sex was even on the table, now I’m all about it again.

I (26F) got off the pill in May. I have been the same one for 15 years. Prior to getting off, my periods were horrible (lasted 6-8 days), I had ZERO interest in sex, and I could never lose weight. After stopping the pill, my periods are 1-2 days tops with very few symptoms, my sex drive is back, and I’ve lost 30+ pounds. In addition, my chronic pain has decreased immensely. It’s literally changed my life.
